traps: both rust-toolchain and rust-toolchain.toml are in the same directory: rustup uses rust-toolchain (the legacy file) and warns, so the toolchain is 1.79.0, not 1.82.0
rust-version = "1.80" is the minimum supported Rust version, a check, not a toolchain choice: with 1.79.0 selected, cargo refuses the package
src/main.rs uses std::sync::LazyLock, stable since 1.80: the toolchain rustup picks cannot compile it
the legacy rust-toolchain file is a bare channel name, not TOML; components and targets exist only in the .toml file, which is ignored
three versions, three meanings: a reader that takes the first file found reports a different toolchain depending on file order
